verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documented power envelope (TDP or board power) and no independent performance-per-watt testing. The only wattage figure is a community builder's passing mention of 600 W per card, and NVIDIA's docs offer only generic 'efficiency' marketing language, so the story is not shown to be delivered. Community remarks about multi-card circuit load and a B300 using 'half the energy' are anecdotal, not perf-per-watt testing of this part.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, sustained workloads are power-efficient on this part — documented power envelopes with independent performance-per-watt testing
